audit_narrative: The story [jira-story-001.md](../../../docs/agent_output/00-jira-stories/jira-story-001.md) asked for pagination, sorting and department/active filtering on `GET /api/v1/employees`, explicitly flagging the bare-array-to-page-envelope response shape as a breaking change to confirm before implementation. The implementation plan [plan_JIRA-001.md](../../../docs/agent_output/02-story-analysis/plan_JIRA-001.md) was marked Approved and laid out the `Pageable`/`Specification`/`PageResponse` approach, naming the response-shape break and the sort-whitelist-before-`Sort`-construction ordering as risks to watch. The developer's report [dev_JIRA-001.md](../../../docs/agent_output/03-development/dev_JIRA-001.md) (Status: Compiled, diff at [dev_JIRA-001.diff](../../../docs/agent_output/03-development/dev_JIRA-001.diff)) implemented all six criteria and explicitly flagged in its own Follow-ups section that `EmployeeControllerTest.testGetAllEmployees_Success` and `_WithBasicAuth` were not updated for the new envelope shape, calling test updates out of the story's affected-files scope. Step 1 verification then ran three independent checks: acceptance-check [acceptance_JIRA-001.md](../../../docs/agent_output/04-verify/acceptance_JIRA-001.md) found all 6 criteria SATISFIED against the patched code; behavior guard [behavior_JIRA-001.md](../../../docs/agent_output/04-verify/behavior_JIRA-001.md) found BEHAVIOR_PRESERVED with zero out-of-scope changes, every hunk tracing to a plan item or a plan-named risk; edge-case review [edgecase_JIRA-001.md](../../../docs/agent_output/04-verify/edgecase_JIRA-001.md) returned GAPS_FOUND, surfacing three boundary issues the plan's approach and out-of-scope list did not address: non-numeric `page`/`size` values bypass the intended 400-with-`ErrorResponse` contract, a blank-but-present `department=` is treated as a real filter instead of 'no filter', and the new `department` filter is case-sensitive while the sibling `/search` endpoint is case-insensitive on the same field. Phase C ran the QA gate [qa_JIRA-001.md](../../../docs/agent_output/05-test-gate/qa_JIRA-001.md) (Passed — new `EmployeeServicePaginationTest` fails on pre-change code, passes on patched code, no live dependency required) and the build gate [build_JIRA-001.md](../../../docs/agent_output/05-test-gate/build_JIRA-001.md) (Failed — `mvn verify` exit 1, 3 failures + 1 error). Of those four failures, one is a real regression this change introduced and the developer's own report anticipated but did not fix: `EmployeeControllerTest.testGetAllEmployees_Success` fails because that existing test was never updated for the new `PageResponse` envelope shape. The remaining three (the Docker-dependent `EmployeeRepositoryIntegrationTest` Testcontainers failure, and two actuator-endpoint 404s on `/actuator/health` and `/actuator/info`) are pre-existing and unrelated to this diff, consistent with the behavior guard's zero-out-of-scope-changes finding, but the build gate's Failed status is binary and blocks regardless of cause. The merge verdict [verdict_JIRA-001.md](../../../docs/agent_output/06-ship/verdict_JIRA-001.md) computed a score of 70/100 against an 85 threshold for this High-priority story (edge-case 0/30, behavior 30/30, QA 40/40) and independently tripped the build-gatekeeper hard gate, landing on **Blocked**. No override was applied — the computed decision already reflects both the score shortfall and the hard gate.
pr_title: [BLOCKED] feat(employee-api): add pagination, sorting and filtering to GET /api/v1/employees (JIRA-001)
pr_summary: This change is currently BLOCKED by the merge verdict — do not merge. See the Blocked banner and additional notes below before taking any action.

GET /api/v1/employees now accepts optional page (default 0), size (default 20, clamped to 100), sort=field,direction (whitelisted to firstName/lastName/email/department/salary/createdAt), and department/active filters, returning a PageResponse envelope (content/page/size/totalElements/totalPages) instead of a bare JSON array.
An unknown sort field or direction now returns 400 with the existing ErrorResponse shape via a new GlobalExceptionHandler.handleIllegalArgument handler, instead of falling through to a 500.
EmployeeRepository now extends JpaSpecificationExecutor<Employee> to support the new Specification-based department/active filtering; no new Maven dependency was required.
/api/v1/employees/search and /api/v1/employees/high-earners are unchanged, confirmed by the behavior guard (zero out-of-scope changes).
pr_test_plan: New regression test EmployeeServicePaginationTest (added by the QA gate) — Passed: proves the Pageable/Specification mapping into PageResponse and the no-op filter Specification when department/active are absent when run against a mocked EmployeeRepository, no live dependency required.

Full build gate (`mvn verify`) — Failed (exit 1, 15 tests run, 3 failures, 1 error): EmployeeControllerTest.testGetAllEmployees_Success fails ('Content type not set') because the existing test was not updated for the new PageResponse envelope shape — this is a real regression introduced by this change and must be fixed before merge.

EmployeeControllerTest.testActuatorHealth_Public and testActuatorInfo_Public fail with 404 — pre-existing, unrelated to this diff per the behavior guard's zero-out-of-scope-changes finding, not caused by this change.

EmployeeRepositoryIntegrationTest errors with 'Could not find a valid Docker environment' — pre-existing Testcontainers/Docker-dependent failure, could not be run in this sandbox and is unrelated to this diff.

Edge-case review flagged three unresolved gaps that were not covered by a test in this pass: non-numeric page/size values return an unhandled framework error instead of the intended 400 ErrorResponse shape, a blank-but-present department= is treated as a literal filter rather than 'no filter', and department filtering is case-sensitive here versus case-insensitive on the sibling /search endpoint.
pr_additional_notes: Merge verdict is Blocked (score 70/100 vs. an 85 threshold for this High-priority story, plus an independent build-gatekeeper hard gate trip) — see verdict_JIRA-001.md. Two things need to happen before this can be reconsidered: (1) fix or update EmployeeControllerTest.testGetAllEmployees_Success/_WithBasicAuth for the new PageResponse envelope shape so the build gate passes cleanly, and (2) decide whether the three edge-case gaps (non-numeric page/size, blank department=, and cross-endpoint department case-sensitivity mismatch with /search) need fixing now or can be explicitly deferred to a follow-up story. The Docker-dependent integration test failure and the two actuator 404s are pre-existing sandbox/environment limitations unrelated to this diff and do not block on their own, but they remain inside the same Failed build gate status.
